pageProps.title: Premonitory Dream
pageProps.review: Keigo Higashino's novel Premonitory Dream explains supernatural mystery cases through the scientific principles of Galileo, posing questions about the coexistence of superstition and science while reminding us of the importance of logical thinking habits.
pageProps.description: Dissecting the occult with the eyes of science
pageProps.content:
## Review It explains events that seem interpretable only supernaturally and mystically, such as premonitory dreams, out-of-body experiences, and poltergeists, through the scientific principles of ```Galileo```.
Beyond simply revealing tricks, it poses the fundamental question of how superstition and science coexist and conflict in modern society.
It explains different mysteries and the scientific principles applied to them in five independent short stories.
The author seems to encourage the habit of doubting phenomena rather than blindly believing them, and thinking logically.
